turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, and I'd like to know why my son found out he had a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
I didn't come to be thanked. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Can you read me your notes word for word?

Word for word, no. You'll have my position in writing. Here's one line: "Procedure 4.2, parent contacted before any mark is entered. Nobody called me."

Now answer my question, Hale. Who decided, and was Owen heard first?
Not those notes. Your instructions. What were you told to do in this meeting?
I wasn't told anything, Hale. I'm here because of a zero my son found out about on his phone. I have a client call at 4:40, so answer the question: who decided, and was Owen heard first?
What do you plan to say if I bring up your daughter?

You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. My daughter has nothing to do with Owen's essay, and the principal's office is one floor up.

Now, who decided on the zero?
